title: The Hate Curve
caption:
Every logo redesign gets hated on day one. Jaguar's rebrand is the proof, and the ending is the lesson.

Swipe to see what two years did.

November 2024: Jaguar launched its rebrand with a film that showed a new logo and no car. Elon Musk replied, "Do you sell cars?"
December 2024: they showed the Type 00 concept.
October 2026: the production car, Type 01, launched.

Gap's 2010 logo never got that second act. It was pulled in about a week.

The difference is whether there's a real idea under the new look. Hate is day one. The verdict is year two.

Send this to whoever on your team is scared of a rebrand.

What rebrand did you hate at first and love now?

We're Blue Particle Studios: motion design, brand films and launch videos. DM us to start yours.
